proof_body:
by
  intro n
  have s2 : Real.sqrt 2 ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have h1 : 1 < Real.sqrt 2 := by
    rw [Real.lt_sqrt (by norm_num)]; norm_num
  have key : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ x y : ℕ, (Real.sqrt 2 - 1) ^ k = (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * (x - y * Real.sqrt 2) ∧
      ((x : ℤ) ^ 2 - 2 * (y : ℤ) ^ 2 = (-1) ^ k) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact ⟨1, 0, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨x, y, hv, hn⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨x + 2 * y, x + y, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [pow_succ, hv, pow_succ]
        push_cast
        linear_combination (-(-1 : ℝ) ^ k * y) * s2 
      · push_cast
        rw [pow_succ (-1 : ℤ) k, ← hn]
        ring
  obtain ⟨x, y, hv, hn⟩ := key n
  have hsq : ∀ z : ℕ, Real.sqrt ((z : ℝ) ^ 2) = z := fun z => Real.sqrt_sq (Nat.cast_nonneg z)
  have hsq2 : Real.sqrt (2 * (y : ℝ) ^ 2) = y * Real.sqrt 2 := by
    rw [mul_comm, Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq (Nat.cast_nonneg y)]
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with he | ho
  · refine ⟨2 * y ^ 2, ?_⟩
    rw [he.neg_one_pow] at hn hv
    have hx : (x : ℝ) ^ 2 = 2 * (y : ℝ) ^ 2 + 1 := by
      have : ((x : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ 2 - 2 * ((y : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ 2 = ((1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
      push_cast at this
      linarith
    push_cast
    rw [← hx, hsq, hsq2, hv]
    ring
  · refine ⟨x ^ 2, ?_⟩
    rw [ho.neg_one_pow] at hn hv
    have hx : (x : ℝ) ^ 2 + 1 = 2 * (y : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have : ((x : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ 2 - 2 * ((y : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ 2 = ((-1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
      push_cast at this
      linarith
    push_cast
    rw [hx, hsq, hsq2, hv]
    ring
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ m : ℕ, (Real.sqrt 2 - 1) ^ n = Real.sqrt ((m : ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt m
